todos: Define the target greenfield presentation architecture and reorganize the WinUI project into explicit Shell, DesignSystem, Features, ViewModels, and UI Services boundaries while preserving one-way dependencies and EN/IT resources.

Extract App.xaml presentation resources into focused typography, spacing, card, button, table, form, and state dictionaries; introduce semantic tokens for page widths, responsive padding, spacing, cells, selection columns, row heights, and breakpoints.

Implement a reusable PageScaffold for title, subtitle, commands, state content, responsive padding and width, scrolling, and footer/status; migrate every feature page and remove duplicated page grids, padding, breakpoints, and action layouts.

Replace PresentationCommand and scattered string command IDs with a typed UiCommand model covering kind, placement, visibility, enablement, icon, tooltip, confirmation, shortcut, and cancellation, then render commands through one responsive OnlyWingetCommandBar with overflow.

Implement centralized StatePresenter models and views for empty, loading, executing, error, and unavailable-capability states, including actions and expandable technical details; replace page StatusText and LoadingStatusText handling for all features.

Implement OperationBanner as the single progress, phase, package/update detail, percentage or indeterminate, cancellation, final-error, and reboot-required surface; remove page-specific progress-text composition.

Implement a typed OnlyWingetTable whose single column definitions generate both headers and cells with shared horizontal scrolling, stable item sources, selection and mixed select-all, selectable/truncated text, compact cards, keyboard navigation, UI Automation, High Contrast, and 200% text scaling.
Migrate Search, Presets, Updates, Windows Update, and Sources to OnlyWingetTable and delete FixedTableLayout, ColumnNWidth resources, and duplicated header/row column definitions.

Introduce feature ViewModels and UI service boundaries for dialogs and confirmations, file picking, clipboard, and navigation; move state mapping, localization, validation, command enablement, progress formatting, row transformation, and picker/dialog orchestration out of page code-behind.

Replace technical-module navigation with a declarative NavigationRegistry for Home, Packages, Updates, Sources, Activity, and Settings, including localized labels, icons, factories, visibility and badges; remove MainWindow navigation switches.

Create Settings on the shared scaffold for language, theme, destructive confirmations, diagnostics/logging, installation behavior, and configuration reset without changing the persisted workspace or preset schemas.

Redesign Packages as one responsive workflow combining active preset, search, selected packages, operation results, import/export actions, add-to-preset state, multi-selection, install/uninstall preview, destructive confirmation, and package/source validation.

Redesign Updates as one responsive workflow with App winget and Windows Update modes, shared scan/apply/cancel commands and filters, coherent tables, row errors, operation summary, and reboot-required state while preserving explicit-only Windows Update scans.
Redesign Sources as validated configuration management with coherent rows/cards, enabled and error state, row actions, source testing where supported, and previewed confirmed remove/reset operations.
Redesign Activity as a diagnostic timeline with severity/category filters, search, expandable technical details, copy/export actions, and confirmed clear or undo behavior.

Redesign Home as an operational overview of winget and Windows Update capability, update/error status, active preset, metrics, warnings, recent activity, and clear quick actions without triggering implicit Windows Update scans.
Centralize validated form models and controls for preset names, package IDs, and sources with inline messages, duplicate detection, accessible labels, and command enablement derived from validity.

Update EN/IT resources, architecture documentation, and UI tests for the new routes and components; remove superseded pages, presentation models, styles, helpers, dead code, and obsolete tests after migration.

Run Setup if restore inputs changed, then Format, Lint, Typecheck, Test, Build, and the automated WinUI suite through repository scripts; fix all failures and leave the successfully launched responsive app running.

On an interactive Windows desktop after the redesign, verify compact, medium, and wide layouts plus vertical and horizontal mouse-wheel behavior over rows, checkboxes, selectable text, headers, and scrollers on every route; assert vertical scroll percentage changes where scrollable.

On an interactive Windows desktop after the redesign, complete keyboard-only, visible-focus, Narrator, UI Automation naming, High Contrast, and 200% text-scaling checks for every route and shared component, and fix all failures.

Validate Windows Update software, driver, Microsoft-product, cancellation during scan and install, malformed-output, COM-failure, partial-failure, and reboot-required flows on clean Windows 10 build 17763 and current Windows 11 hosts.

Run destructive live winget install, upgrade, uninstall, cancellation, concurrent-command rejection, progress, localized-output, Unicode, variable-column, and multiple-source smoke tests on a disposable Windows host with controlled test packages.

Validate the MSI, Burn setup, and self-contained portable ZIP lifecycle on a clean elevated x64 Windows host, including Windows App Runtime chaining, installed and portable startup, Programs and Features registration, clean install, upgrade, uninstall, and artifact architecture checks.
Run the hosted GitHub Actions build gate for the exact release commit before tagging.
